title: Payment Plan Length for Established Home Delivery Pharmacy Accounts
content:
## Credit office rate table: account history and plan length

**Rule.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy payment plan, a plan is lengthened for an established account: by two months when the account has been open 120 whole months or more and shows six or more shipped orders (replacement shipments are not counted) dated less than 12 whole months before the handling date, by one month when the account has been open at least 12 whole months and shows at least two such shipments without meeting the two-month test, and not at all in every other case.

Months open are whole months from the account's opened date to the handling date. Shipped orders are the account's shipment records; replacement shipments are a different kind of record and are not counted.

### Lengthening table

| Whole months open | Shipped orders dated less than 12 whole months before the handling date | Plan lengthened by |
|---|---|---|
| 120 or more | 6 or more | 2 months |
| 120 or more | 2 to 5 | 1 month |
| 12 through 119 | 2 or more | 1 month |
| 12 or more | 0 or 1 | none |
| fewer than 12 | any | none |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical accounts)

- 120 whole months open, 6 shipments in the span: 2 months. 119 whole months open, 9 shipments: 1 month.
- 12 whole months open, 2 shipments: 1 month. 11 whole months open, 8 shipments: none.
- 150 whole months open, 5 shipments and 3 replacement shipments: 5 shipments count, so 1 month.
